tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and monotone-concave behavior are compatible with the basin-siphon mechanism, but the five rows leave the branch term ambiguous. Acquire the lower-cost open-branch discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the hydraulic basin siphon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations at one forecast horizon do not identify the branch contribution or distinguish it reliably from the recalled smooth alternatives.
A targeted open-branch measurement is more directly informative about the unresolved branch term and costs less.
It is irrelevant to the identified uncertainty and has higher cost.
